Limousine bus to Myeongdong: Incheon Airport → Myeongdong (limousine 6015)
Airport limousine buses leave from the arrivals floor (1F). Route 6015 goes to Myeongdong and stops near the big hotels.
How do you buy the ticket?
At the ticket counter or kiosk in the arrivals hall – or tap a T-money/credit card on board
Right. Tell the staff "명동" (Myeongdong) and check the stop number on the ticket.
Pay the driver in US dollars
Drivers only take Korean cards or won. Buy a ticket at the counter first.
The driver opens the luggage hold. What do you do with your suitcase?
Put it in the hold and keep the luggage tag – take valuables and my passport on board
Perfect. The tag proves the bag is yours at your stop.
Carry the big suitcase into the aisle
It blocks the aisle and is unsafe if the bus brakes. Big bags go in the hold.
The bus joins the expressway. What is required?
Fasten the seat belt – it is the law on expressway buses
Right. Seat belts are compulsory on intercity and airport buses.
Stand up to take photos while it drives
Standing is not allowed on expressway buses – stay seated with the belt on.
About 70 minutes later the screen shows "명동 Myeongdong". You get off with your bag and walk to the hotel.

The meter runs and you cross the long bridges. What adds to the fare?
Expressway tolls – they are paid on top of the meter
Right. Ask for a receipt (영수증 주세요). With tolls it is ₩60,000–90,000 – next time try AREX or the limousine bus.
Nothing – the meter shows everything
